narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Moonsight Rifle, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ohoho, I take it back. Look at this beautiful boomstick. I bet it'll knock a satyr's head clean off. Thanks pal, now step aside or you're going to get caught in the crossfire.
narrative.requestItemsText: Hey, HEY, man, haven't you heard of a little thing called "subtlety"? Spell it out with me, S-U-B...LETY. You're going to blow my cover!
